title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures drift higher despite Treasury yield pressures persisting
title_zh: 今日股市：尽管国债收益率压力持续存在，道指、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货走高
summary: Stocks were headed for weekly losses after a bond sell-off this week put pressure on tech and AI stocks.
summary_zh: 本周债券抛售给科技和人工智能股带来压力后，股市每周都会下跌。

title: ChatGPT Can Now Control iMessage, Potentially Raising Apple Privacy Concerns
title_zh: ChatGPT 现在可以控制 iMessage，可能会引发 Apple 隐私问题
summary: OpenAI rolled out support on Thursday for controlling Apple Inc.’s iMessage service via ChatGPT, a move with the potential to raise privacy concerns for the iPhone maker.
summary_zh: OpenAI 周四推出了通过 ChatGPT 控制苹果公司 iMessage 服务的支持，此举可能会引发这家 iPhone 制造商的隐私担忧。

title: Broadcom seeks more than $60 billion in latest AI debt deal, Bloomberg News reports
title_zh: 据彭博社报道，博通在最新的人工智能债务交易中寻求超过 600 亿美元的资金
summary: Broadcom is in talks with a group of lenders to raise more than $60 billion in debt for an AI ‌chip financing deal that will benefit Anthropic and other companies, ‌Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 彭博新闻周四援引知情人士的话报道称，博通正在与一组贷方进行谈判，为一项人工智能芯片融资协议筹集超过 600 亿美元的债务，这将使 Anthropic 和其他公司受益。

title: Waymo is making its own AI chip for its robotaxi service
title_zh: Waymo 正在为其机器人出租车服务制造自己的人工智能芯片
summary: Autonomous rideshare operator — which is owned by Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) — has begun building its own AI chips to better optimize sensor data, according to Bloomberg. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley examines Waymo's move to bring more of its technology in-house.
summary_zh: 据彭博社报道，Alphabet（GOOG、GOOGL）旗下的自动拼车运营商已开始构建自己的人工智能芯片，以更好地优化传感器数据。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 探讨了 Waymo 将更多技术引入内部的举措。

title: Meta Is Now One of Microsoft's Largest AI Customers
title_zh: Meta 现在是微软最大的人工智能客户之一
summary: Meta has quietly become one of Microsoft's largest AI customers, spending hundreds of millions of dollars a year to access the Azure cloud service - and reviving concerns around circular business dealings in the AI space.
summary_zh: Meta 已悄然成为微软最大的人工智能客户之一，每年花费数亿美元访问 Azure 云服务，并再次引发人们对人工智能领域循环业务交易的担忧。

title: Stocks dip as bond yields and oil rise, Walmart earnings drag on retail: AlphaCheck
title_zh: 随着债券收益率和油价上涨，股市下跌，沃尔玛盈利拖累零售业：AlphaCheck
summary: Stocks got off to an unsteady start to trading as Treasury yields regained some of their losses from the day before.
summary_zh: 随着美国国债收益率收复前一天的部分跌幅，股市开局不稳定。

title: Tech stocks today: Anthropic's IPO plans come into focus, Nvidia earnings provide next test for AI trade
title_zh: 今日科技股：Anthropic IPO计划成为焦点，英伟达财报为人工智能行业提供下一个考验
summary: Tech stock coverage for the week of Aug. 17.
summary_zh: 8 月 17 日当周的科技股报道。
